messages.subject: Project Falcon - charges model for the file
messages.plaintextBody:
Rohan,

For the closing file, attached is the charges model reflecting the executed terms: £62.4m supply across the milestone schedule (10% advance), plus CPI-indexed licence (£840k) and service (£1.95m) charges over the 7-year term. On these assumptions the total contract value over the term is c.£83.8m. Let me know if you want the CPI assumption flexed.

Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
